/.title: Macdio: Live Radio & Podcasts
/.description: 60,000+ radio stations and 4.7 million podcasts for Mac, iPhone, iPad and Apple TV. On-device transcripts, live radio recording, synced lyrics, song ID.

/features.html.title: Macdio Features: Everything the App Does
/features.html.description: The complete Macdio feature list: streaming engine, station discovery, song identification with no microphone, split-track recording, synced lyrics, podcasts.

/iphone.html.title: Internet Radio App for iPhone with CarPlay | Macdio
/iphone.html.description: The iPhone has no FM radio, but internet radio fills the gap. Macdio streams 60,000+ stations with CarPlay, widgets, recording and song ID.

/ipad.html.title: Internet Radio App for iPad | Macdio
/ipad.html.description: Internet radio on iPad with Macdio: 60,000+ stations, full-screen synced lyrics, recording, microphone-free song identification. One purchase, no subscription.

/mac.html.title: Mac Radio App: 60,000 Stations in the Menu Bar | Macdio
/mac.html.description: Macdio is a native Mac radio player that lives in the menu bar. 60,000 stations, recording, synced lyrics and song ID. One purchase, no subscription.

/apple-tv.html.title: Internet Radio for Apple TV: 60,000+ Stations | Macdio
/apple-tv.html.description: Yes, Apple TV can play internet radio. Macdio streams 60,000+ stations with Top Shelf favorites, big-screen Now Playing and controller support.

/apple-watch.html.title: Standalone Radio App for Apple Watch | Macdio
/apple-watch.html.description: Apple Watch can stream radio without the iPhone. Macdio plays 60,000+ stations from the wrist over Wi-Fi or cellular to Bluetooth headphones.

/stations.html.title: Station Directory: 60,000+ Internet Radio Stations
/stations.html.description: Browse 60,000+ internet radio stations worldwide. Search by name, country or genre. Powered by Radio Browser, the community-maintained database.

/submit-station.html.title: Submit a Station: Add Your Radio to Macdio
/submit-station.html.description: Add your radio station to Macdio through Radio Browser, the free directory the app gets its 50,000+ stations from.

/tunein-alternative.html.description: No ads, no subscription and no account, on every Apple device you own. Where TuneIn still wins, and where it does not, from the developer of the alternative.

/carplay.html.title: Macdio on CarPlay: Radio and Podcasts in the Car
/carplay.html.description: Radio stations, podcasts and Song ID on the CarPlay screen with Macdio for iPhone. One purchase, no subscription.

/features/podcast-transcripts.html.title: Podcast Transcripts on Device: Macdio
/features/podcast-transcripts.html.description: Macdio transcribes any podcast episode on your device, in the episode’s language, with no server and no limit. Read along, search, jump to a sentence.

/features/synced-lyrics.html.description: Macdio shows time-synced lyrics for the song playing on a radio station, aligned to what you hear, with the identified song as the anchor.

/mytuner-alternative.html.title: myTuner Alternative for iPhone and Mac: Macdio
/mytuner-alternative.html.description: Macdio compared with myTuner Radio: one-time purchase instead of subscriptions and ads, native Mac app, Song ID, recording, podcasts with transcripts.

/pocket-casts-alternative.html.title: Pocket Casts Alternative Without a Subscription: Macdio
/pocket-casts-alternative.html.description: Macdio compared with Pocket Casts: transcripts on device instead of Plus, Highlights export, one purchase for every Apple device, plus live radio.

/overcast-alternative.html.title: Overcast Podcast App Alternative for Mac and iPhone: Macdio
/overcast-alternative.html.description: Macdio compared with Overcast: a native Mac app, Apple TV, on-device transcripts and Highlights, one purchase instead of ads or a yearly plan.

/snipd-alternative.html.title: Snipd Alternative with Apple Notes Export: Macdio
/snipd-alternative.html.description: Macdio compared with Snipd: Highlights to Apple Notes, Craft, Obsidian, Readwise, Notion and Bear, transcripts on device, no monthly plan, radio included.

/compare/apple-podcasts.html.title: Macdio vs Apple Podcasts: Transcripts and Highlights
/compare/apple-podcasts.html.description: Where Apple Podcasts transcripts stop and Macdio continues: every episode on device, search inside, Highlights to your notes app, plus live radio in one app.

hub.heading: What changed, and what people are asking
hub.lede: Release notes, bug reports and feature requests live on the community hub. Every entry below links to the thread.

home.h1: Radio and podcasts, on every Apple screen.
home.lede: {stations} live stations and {podcasts} podcasts in one app, bought once for iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple TV, Apple Watch and CarPlay. Song ID reads the stream, so it never asks for the microphone. Transcripts are made on your device.
home.heroCaption: Song ID on iPhone, from the stream

tour.caption: Song ID while a station plays
tour.h: Name the song without listening in.
tour.p: Tap Song ID and Macdio works out what the station is playing from the audio it already receives. No microphone permission, nothing recorded. Save the track or open it in Apple Music.

tour.caption: A podcast transcript, made on the phone
tour.p: Play a podcast and the transcript is made on your iPhone, iPad or Mac, in the episode's language. Search inside it and jump to the sentence you want.

tour.caption: A highlight sent to Apple Notes
tour.p: Mark what you just heard and it goes to Apple Notes, Notion, Obsidian, Bear, Craft or Readwise, with the sentence and a link back to the episode.

tour.caption: Recordings, one file per song
tour.h: Record the stream, get a tagged library.
tour.p: On iPhone, iPad and Mac, recording follows the station's song titles and splits the stream into tracks. Set a maximum length and it stops on its own.

tour.caption: Synced lyrics on live radio
tour.h: Lyrics that keep up with live radio.
tour.p: Synced lyrics line up with what you hear, anchored on the song Macdio identified.

tour.caption: The Mac menu bar player
tour.p: Native on the Mac, with a menu bar player and keyboard shortcuts. The same library and the same purchase as on the phone.

screens.h: The same library on the big screen, on your wrist and in the car.
screens.p: One purchase, one iCloud library. Your own stations can be edited from a computer: the iPhone, iPad or Apple TV serves a small editor page on your Wi-Fi, protected by a PIN.

business.p: Macdio is made by one person. You pay once on the App Store and get every platform and every update. There is no account to create, no advertising, no analytics in the app and no subscription.

compare.h: Compared with the apps you may be using now

faq.q: Is there an app that allows me to listen to FM radio on all my Apple devices?
faq.a: Macdio plays internet streams of FM and AM stations on iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple TV, Apple Watch and CarPlay from one purchase. It does not receive FM over the air; no iPhone does.

faq.q: Which radio app has the fewest ads?
faq.a: Macdio shows none and never has. The stations' own broadcast ads are part of the stream, as on the air.

faq.q: Is it worth paying for a podcast app?
faq.a: Macdio is one payment, not a subscription. Transcripts, chapters, highlights and sync are included; nothing is held back for a higher tier.

faq.q: Can I transfer my subscriptions between apps?
faq.a: Yes. Macdio imports and exports OPML, so subscriptions move over from Overcast, Pocket Casts or any app that exports OPML, and back out again if you leave.

faq.q: Is there an Android or web version?
faq.a: No. Macdio is built for Apple devices only, and the directory of stations is on this site.
